"""Tests for the independent word_count contribution."""

from pathlib import Path

from ourob.skills.base import SkillContext
from ourob.skills.registry import SkillRegistry
from ourob.state.model import Invocation

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _dispatch(text: str) -> str:
    registry = SkillRegistry(REPO)
    registry.discover()
    result = registry.dispatch(
        Invocation(skill="word_count", args={"text": text}),
        SkillContext(repo=REPO),
    )
    assert result.ok, result.error
    return result.output


def test_word_count_is_discovered() -> None:
    registry = SkillRegistry(REPO)
    registry.discover()
    assert registry.has("word_count")


def test_word_count_counts_whitespace_delimited_words() -> None:
    assert _dispatch("Ourob invites independent verification") == "4"
    assert _dispatch("  one two  ") == "2"
